terms.comment: Morgan–Owens finds it much more common than Madritum. A town takes no preposition: Matrītum (to), Matrītī (in, at), Matrītō (from).

matritum.html: The long vowel puts the Latin stress where Spanish Madrid has it, by the convention for modern names.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio, geographical section, with the authorities it cites (cited as M-O s.v.).
